title: vitis laevigata
intro: Vitis laevigata, commonly known as Chinese wild grape, is a type of plant that belongs to the Vitaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Vitis laevigata include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilator, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as hypertension, atherosclerosis, and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of Vitis laevigata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
